cold: #197's cold test: written before the pose, from the sources alone. Don't read it while posing this lift, and tune neither to the other.
sources: No library video. Searched reference: IU-ERkjTKXA, so weaker than the others
docs/research/grip.md: a rope, mid-palm, the fist just above the end stop

lines.says: the hips hinge from near straight to deeply folded
the trunk goes from near upright to well forward
the knees stay soft: a hinge, not a squat
the arms hold their angle: the hips pull, not the arms
the hips drive back and through
the lifter faces away from the tower, the cable running between the legs from a low pulley
at the hinge the back stays flat, not rounded
the hands pass between the legs at the hinge and rise to the front of the hips
